title: Replace opposed-polarity cells under a spring-return service cover
instruction: Open the sliding cover. Put both grey used cells in the grey collection tray. Install the two blue replacements with each orange positive end at its orange terminal, then close the cover.
context: The task measures replacement under sustained access support: two used identities must leave, opposite polarities must match spring contacts, and the spring-return cover must close. It is a bench service fixture, not a replica of a particular remote.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; x forward, y left, z up; metres/kg/radians; XYZW quaternions. Tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed layout, seed 0, no object jitter. Each object below is an authored rigid body or cable-chain link; dimensions are collision envelopes. Shapes, local offsets, colors and joints are fully enumerated in scene.json. controller: rigid engineering plastic, 0.18 kg, envelope (0.13, 0.132, 0.032) m, origin (0.29, 0, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). cover: rigid engineering plastic, 0.06 kg, envelope (0.126, 0.307, 0.0285) m, origin (0.29, 0, 0.7815), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). contact_0: rigid engineering plastic, 0.002 kg, envelope (0.002, 0.014, 0.013) m, origin (0.2645, -0.033, 0.76275), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). contact_1: rigid engineering plastic, 0.002 kg, envelope (0.002, 0.014, 0.013) m, origin (0.3155, 0.033, 0.76275), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). used_cell_tray: rigid engineering plastic, 0.5 kg, envelope (0.144, 0.104, 0.04) m, origin (0.39, -0.24, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). old_cell_0: rigid AA cell surrogate; no electrical or chemical simulation, 0.024 kg, envelope (0.0518, 0.0145, 0.0145) m, origin (0.29, -0.033, 0.76275), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). new_cell_0: rigid AA cell surrogate; no electrical or chemical simulation, 0.024 kg, envelope (0.0518, 0.0145, 0.0145) m, origin (0.16, -0.24, 0.75495), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). old_cell_1: rigid AA cell surrogate; no electrical or chemical simulation, 0.024 kg, envelope (0.0518, 0.0145, 0.0145) m, origin (0.29, 0.033, 0.76275), XYZW (0, 0, 1, 6.12323e-17). new_cell_1: rigid AA cell surrogate; no electrical or chemical simulation, 0.024 kg, envelope (0.0518, 0.0145, 0.0145) m, origin (0.24, -0.24, 0.75495), XYZW (0, 0, 1, 6.12323e-17). new_cell_staging_rails: anchored rigid engineering plastic, 0.08 kg, envelope (0.138, 0.028, 0.002) m, origin (0.2, -0.24, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1); four 2 mm-high rails with 20 mm openings. The used-cell tray includes two 20 mm-clear anti-roll lanes centred at world Y −0.262 and −0.218 m, using four 58 × 4 × 2 mm ribs above its floor.
scoring: 0.2 for old_cell_0_collected; 0.2 for old_cell_1_collected; 0.2 for new_cell_0_installed; 0.2 for new_cell_1_installed; 0.2 for cover_closed. Each goal requires all numeric predicates in SCORING.md and scene.json. Credit is recomputed, so dislodged components lose credit. Full score also requires all bodies <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, robot clearance >=0.02 m, continuously for 1.0 s; otherwise score is capped at 0.95. Invalid frames, lost parts, fixture motion, broken preservation constraints, joint-limit violations or penetration >0.002 m permanently score zero. Interchangeable parts may occupy any valid slot; one-to-one matching preserves required polarity, contact and measured thread history.
run_limit: 6000 control actions at 20 Hz (300 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Rigid cells, polarity markers and passive spring-contact shoes approximate terminals. A 2.5 N/m spring returns the sliding service cover, with an extended handle for YAM. The fixture models handling, identity and geometric contact readiness; it does not simulate voltage, chemistry or a commercial remote. Low staging rails bound fresh-cell rolling.
scores: NOT RUN: native physics, expert demonstrations and Dream-1 evaluation have not been executed.
